en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside town framed by hills. In the foreground is a broad river with a stone embankment; a man in dark clothes stands near a small structure with a red-tiled roof. Across the river are trees, a small church-like building, and several larger houses or public buildings ascending a road toward the hills. Printed red text at the top identifies the scene in Romanian.
